### **加载R包**

```{r include=FALSE,collapse=TRUE}
library(dplyr) # mutate
library(tidyr) # %>% 
library(caret) # createFolds
library(survival) # coxph
library(pROC) # roc, auc, ci
library(binom) # binom.confint

library(ggplot2) # ggplot
```


### **读取数据**

```{r include=FALSE,collapse=TRUE}
gcrc_data <- readRDS("./output_data/gcrc/data_analyze_gcrc.rds")

data0 <- gcrc_data # 分析数据data1
```

#### *查看数据*

```{r collapse=TRUE}
dput(names(data0))
# str(data0)
skimr::skim(data0)
``` 


## **数据预处理**

```{r collapse=TRUE}
# 胃癌数据
gc_data <- data0 %>%
  mutate(PGI=log10(PGI),
         PGII=log10(PGII),
         PGR=log10(PGR),
         G17=log10(G17)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Stomach))

gc_data$Stomach <- as.numeric(as.character(gc_data$Stomach))

# 肠癌数据
crc_data <- data0 %>%
  mutate(PGI=log10(PGI),
         PGII=log10(PGII),
         PGR=log10(PGR),
         G17=log10(G17)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Colorectal))

crc_data$Colorectal <- as.numeric(as.character(crc_data$Colorectal))

# 胃肠癌数据
gcrc_data <- data0 %>%
  mutate(PGI=log10(PGI),
         PGII=log10(PGII),
         PGR=log10(PGR),
         G17=log10(G17)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(gcrc))

gcrc_data$gcrc <- as.numeric(as.character(gcrc_data$gcrc))
```


## **PGI + PGII**

#### *胃癌模型*

```{r collapse=TRUE}
max=0  
num=0 
set.seed(2580)
folds <- createFolds(y=gc_data$Stomach,k=5)

# 使用lapply进行循环计算AUC
auc_values_gc <- lapply(1:5, function(i) {
  test <- gc_data[folds[[i]], ]
  train <- gc_data[-folds[[i]], ]
  
  # 拟合Cox比例风险模型
  model <- coxph(Surv(time, Stomach) ~ PGI + PGII +
                   Age_clas + Sex + Smoking + Drinking + History,
                 data = train, x = TRUE)
  
  # 预测线性预测值
  fold_predict <- predict(model, type = "lp", newdata = test)
  
  # 计算AUC值
  auc(as.numeric(unlist(test[, "Stomach"])), fold_predict)
})

# 找到AUC最大值的索引
num_gc <- which.max(auc_values_gc)

# 使用最佳折叠进行最终模型训练和预测
fold_test_gc <- gc_data[folds[[num_gc]], ]
fold_train_gc <- gc_data[-folds[[num_gc]], ]

# 拟合最终的Cox模型
final_model_gc <- coxph(Surv(time, Stomach) ~ PGI + PGII +
                   Age_clas + Sex + Smoking + Drinking + History,
                   data = fold_train_gc)

# 预测
fold_predict_gc <- predict(final_model_gc, 
                                    type = "lp", 
                                    newdata = fold_test_gc)

# 生成ROC曲线
roc_curve_gc <- roc(as.numeric(fold_test_gc[, "Stomach"]), fold_predict_gc)

# 计算并输出95%置信区间
roc_ci_gc <- ci(roc_curve_gc)
auc_value_gc <- auc(roc_curve_gc)

# 格式化输出
gc_gc <- paste0(
  sprintf("%.3f",auc_value_gc), 
  " (", 
  sprintf("%.3f",roc_ci_gc[1]), 
  "-", 
  sprintf("%.3f",roc_ci_gc[3]), 
  ")")

gc_gc
```

#### 对应Youden指数

```{r collapse=TRUE}
youden_index_gc <- roc_curve_gc$thresholds[which.max(roc_curve_gc$sensitivities + roc_curve_gc$specificities -1)]

# 找到对应的敏感性和特异性
optimal_sensitivity <- roc_curve_gc$sensitivities[which.max(roc_curve_gc$sensitivities + roc_curve_gc$specificities -1)]
optimal_specificity <- roc_curve_gc$specificities[which.max(roc_curve_gc$sensitivities + roc_curve_gc$specificities -1)]

# 打印结果
cat("Youden Index:", youden_index_gc, "\n")
cat("Optimal Sensitivity:", optimal_sensitivity, "\n")
cat("Optimal Specificity:", optimal_specificity, "\n")
```

### **模型间auc比较**

```{r collapse=TRUE}
set.seed(43)
roc.test(roc_curve_gc,roc_curve_crc,method='bootstrap',boot.n=500) #胃癌 vs 肠癌
set.seed(43)
roc.test(roc_curve_crc,roc_curve_gcrc,method='bootstrap',boot.n=500) #肠癌 vs 胃肠癌
set.seed(43)
roc.test(roc_curve_gc,roc_curve_gcrc,method='bootstrap',boot.n=500) #胃癌 vs 胃肠癌
```


### **绘图**

#### 数据准备

```{r collapse=TRUE}
# 定义模型及对应变量名
models <- c("gc", "crc", "gcrc")

# 创建 ROC 数据（specificity 和 sensitivity）
roc_data <- purrr::map_dfr(models, function(model) {
  roc_obj <- get(paste0("roc_curve_", model))
  data.frame(
    model = model,
    specificity = roc_obj$specificities,
    sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities
  )
})

# 构建 AUC 数据及置信区间
auc_data <- data.frame(
  model = models,
  auc = sapply(models, function(m) get(paste0("auc_value_", m))),
  ci_lower = sapply(models, function(m) get(paste0("roc_ci_", m))[1]),
  ci_upper = sapply(models, function(m) get(paste0("roc_ci_", m))[3])
)

# 合并数据并添加 AUC 标签信息
roc_auc <- dplyr::left_join(roc_data, auc_data, by = "model") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    auc_info = sprintf("%s: %.3f (%.3f–%.3f)", model, auc, ci_lower, ci_upper)
  )

# 定义颜色和标签
# colors <- c("#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd", "#8c564b", "#e377c2")
# colors <- c("#efc000", "#0c6db3", "#cd534c") # 只保留三种颜色
colors <- c("#0f99b2", "#ffa040", "#ff0000") # 只保留三种颜色

roc_auc$auc_info <- factor(roc_auc$auc_info, levels = unique(roc_auc$auc_info))

names(colors) <- levels(roc_auc$auc_info)
```


#### 输出图形

```{r collapse=TRUE}
pdf(file="./output_plot/model/gcrc_model/combine_all-S.pdf",width=6*1.25,height=6)

ggplot(roc_auc, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity, color = auc_info)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) + # curves colors
  labs(x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity", title = "") +
  theme_classic() +
  
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = c(0.7, 0.2), # 调整图例位置
    legend.key.height = unit(0.65, "cm"), # 调整图例键高度调整legend行间距

    # legend.box = "horizontal",
    # legend.box.background = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5), # 设置图例边框颜色
    # legend.box.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5, unit = "pt"), # 图例边框与图例内容的距离
    
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12), # 调整坐标轴文字大小
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),  # 调整xy轴标题大小
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),  # 设置坐标轴线宽度
    
    plot.margin = unit(rep(10, 4), "pt"),  # 调整图形边距
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5)  # 居中显示标题，设置字体大小
  )

dev.off()
```



### **输出更多模型信息**

```{r collapse=TRUE}
models <- c("gc", "crc", "gcrc")

results <- lapply(models, function(model) {
  pred <- get(paste0("fold_predict_", model))
  test <- get(paste0("fold_test_", model))
  youden <- get(paste0("youden_index_", model))
  
  # 确定结局变量的名称
  # 根据 model 选择正确的 outcome_var
  outcome_var <- switch(model,
    "gc" = "Stomach",
    "crc" = "Colorectal",
    "gcrc" = "gcrc"
  )

  # 基于 Youden 指数将预测值转换为二元分类
  predicted_classes <- ifelse(pred >= youden, 1, 0)

  # 计算混淆矩阵
  conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(
    data = factor(predicted_classes),
    reference = factor(test[[outcome_var]], levels = c(0, 1)), # 确保 reference levels 正确
    positive = "1"
  )
  
  sensitivity <- conf_matrix$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  specificity <- conf_matrix$byClass["Specificity"]
  accuracy <- conf_matrix$overall["Accuracy"]
  ppv <- conf_matrix$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
  npv <- conf_matrix$byClass["Neg Pred Value"]
  
  sens_ci <- binom.confint(conf_matrix$table[2,2], sum(conf_matrix$table[,2]), method = "wilson")
  spec_ci <- binom.confint(conf_matrix$table[1,1], sum(conf_matrix$table[,1]), method = "wilson")
  acc_ci  <- binom.confint(sum(diag(conf_matrix$table)), sum(conf_matrix$table), method = "wilson")
  ppv_ci  <- binom.confint(conf_matrix$table[2,2], sum(conf_matrix$table[2,]), method = "wilson")
  npv_ci  <- binom.confint(conf_matrix$table[1,1], sum(conf_matrix$table[1,]), method = "wilson")
  
  # 格式化输出字符串
  fmt <- function(est, lower, upper) {
    paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est), " (", sprintf("%.3f", lower), "–", sprintf("%.3f", upper), ")")
  }
  
  data.frame(
    model = model,
    "Sensitivity (95% CI)"  = fmt(sensitivity, sens_ci$lower, sens_ci$upper),
    "Specificity (95% CI)"  = fmt(specificity, spec_ci$lower, spec_ci$upper),
    "Accuracy (95% CI)"     = fmt(accuracy, acc_ci$lower, acc_ci$upper),
    "PPV (95% CI)"          = fmt(ppv, ppv_ci$lower, ppv_ci$upper),
    "NPV (95% CI)"          = fmt(npv, npv_ci$lower, npv_ci$upper),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
})

# 合并所有更多模型结果
summary_df <- bind_rows(results)

# 合并所有模型信息
summary_model <- dplyr::left_join(auc_data, summary_df, by = "model") %>%
  dplyr::mutate("AUC (95% CI)" = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
                                        auc, ci_lower, ci_upper)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-auc, -ci_lower, -ci_upper) %>%
  dplyr::relocate("AUC (95% CI)", .after = model)

print(summary_model)
```
